name: Night Flores
source:
A researcher was tasked to go to a small town and research a mysterious flower that has unnatural properties.

They were given a month to stay and learn about it.

It was either an act of needing actual research or their boss wanted to have them leave the house for once.

But now that is their task and they will meet a bunch of other characters on the way.

[From [url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/nightflores]Itch.io[/url]]
